fn public_f64_binary(s:mutbuf,operation:u64,left:u64,right:u64) -> (u64) effects(read,write,trap) entry(start)
block start(s:mutbuf,operation:u64,left:u64,right:u64)
  ld:u64 = call(s,left) {"function":"tensor_dtype"}
  rd:u64 = call(s,right) {"function":"tensor_dtype"}
  four:u64 = const() {"value":4}
  two:u64 = const() {"value":2}
  one:u64 = const() {"value":1}
  ldouble:bool = compare.eq(ld,four)
  rdouble:bool = compare.eq(rd,four)
  anydouble:bool = bool.or(ldouble,rdouble)
  different:bool = compare.ne(ld,rd)
  mixed:bool = bool.and(anydouble,different)
  lsmall:bool = compare.le(ld,two)
  rsmall:bool = compare.le(rd,two)
  lpublic:bool = bool.or(lsmall,ldouble)
  rpublic:bool = bool.or(rsmall,rdouble)
  public:bool = bool.and(lpublic,rpublic)
  types:bool = bool.and(mixed,public)
  lower:bool = compare.ge(operation,one)
  upper:bool = compare.le(operation,four)
  arithmetic:bool = bool.and(lower,upper)
  admitted:bool = bool.and(types,arithmetic)
  branch admitted select_operation(s,operation,left,right) previous(s,operation,left,right)
block previous(sp:mutbuf,op:u64,lp:u64,rp:u64)
  originalp:u64 = call(sp,op,lp,rp) {"function":"half_mul_previous_binary"}
  ret(originalp)
block select_operation(s1:mutbuf,o1:u64,l1:u64,r1:u64)
  two1:u64 = const() {"value":2}
  addsub1:bool = compare.le(o1,two1)
  branch addsub1 addsub(s1,o1,l1,r1) select_product(s1,o1,l1,r1)
block addsub(s2:mutbuf,o2:u64,l2:u64,r2:u64)
  result2:u64 = call(s2,o2,l2,r2) {"function":"half_addsub_tensor"}
  ret(result2)
block select_product(s3:mutbuf,o3:u64,l3:u64,r3:u64)
  three3:u64 = const() {"value":3}
  multiply3:bool = compare.eq(o3,three3)
  branch multiply3 multiply(s3,o3,l3,r3) divide(s3,o3,l3,r3)
block multiply(s4:mutbuf,o4:u64,l4:u64,r4:u64)
  result4:u64 = call(s4,o4,l4,r4) {"function":"half_mul_tensor"}
  ret(result4)
block divide(s5:mutbuf,o5:u64,l5:u64,r5:u64)
  result5:u64 = call(s5,o5,l5,r5) {"function":"half_div_tensor"}
  ret(result5)
end
